({{IPA|de|ɛs faʊ̯ ˌvɛʁdɐ ˈbʁeːmən|-|De-SV Werder Bremen.ogg}}), commonly known as '''Werder Bremen''', '''Werder''' or simply '''Bremen''', is a German professional [[sports club]] based in [[Bremen]]. Founded on 4 February 1899, Werder are best known for their professional [[association football]] team, who compete in the [[Bundesliga]], the first tier of the [[German football league system]]. Bremen share the record for most seasons played in the Bundesliga with [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]], and are ranked third in the [[all-time Bundesliga table]], only behind Bayern and [[Borussia Dortmund]].{{Cite web|title=Germany – Bundesliga All-Time Tables 1963/64-2018/19|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duialltime.html|last=Pietarinen|first=Heikki|date=25 July 2019|publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=15 May 2020|archive-date=8 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220808010826/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duialltime.html}} Werder have been [[List of German football champions|German champions]] four times, have won the [[DFB-Pokal]] six times, the [[DFL-Ligapokal]] once, the [[DFL-Supercup]] thrice, and the [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup|European Cup Winners' Cup]] once. The team's first major trophy was the [[1960–61 DFB-Pokal]]; they last won the cup in [[2008–09 DFB-Pokal|2008–09]]. Bremen's first German championship came in [[1964–65 Bundesliga|1964–65]], and their latest in [[2003–04 Bundesliga|2003–04]], when they won the [[Double (association football)|double]]. In [[UEFA competitions|European football]], Werder won the [[1991–92 European Cup Winners' Cup]], and were runners-up in the [[2008–09 UEFA Cup]]. Bremen have played at the [[Weserstadion]] since 1909. The club shares a rivalry with fellow northern German club [[Hamburger SV]], known as the [[Nordderby]] ({{lit|North derby}}). In April 2022, Werder had over 40,000 members.{{Cite web |title=SV Werder Bremen – Profil |url=https://www.sport.de/fussball/te2134/sv-werder-bremen/ |access-date=26 April 2022 |website=sport.de |language=de |archive-date=29 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220529021304/https://www.sport.de/fussball/te2134/sv-werder-bremen/}}"}}
